raw_support_texts: We compared the miRNA expression profiles of the three parental (chemo-naive) CRC cell lines HT29, HCT116, and RKO with those of their oxaliplatin-resistant derivative cells by using miRNA microarray chip analysis with about 1200 premiRNA and mature human miRNA probes (Suppl. Table S1-S3).
interpretation: These selected record-level Support passages describe resistant-versus-parental miRNA microarrays. They do not establish intervention-effect reversals for the selected miRNAs. The paper also contains functional experiments for miR-203; this must not be projected onto every miRNA in its microarray. Full-paper and supplement review remains necessary; no automatic exclusion or relabeling performed.
